label: EPROM
description: Your own dump of the unit's V1.0 program EPROM (27256, 32 KB). Not included.
hint: Read the EPROM of your own unit with an EPROM reader.

rules.label: V1.0 EPROM
rules.note: The plugin checks it when it loads: an EPROM other than the tested V1.0 dump still runs, and the display shows Unknown EPROM for a few seconds.
